```{r}
#| label: setup

library(reticulate)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
# Docs-build only. Load scipy's C++ runtime before torch (some environments
# otherwise pick up an older system libstdc++), set table display options, and
# work around reticulate redirecting every logging handler's `stream` while it
# captures output: torch's stderr handler has a read-only `stream` that already
# follows sys.stderr, so make the redirect a no-op. One function call, so torch
# is imported and patched within a single captured statement.
import scipy.spatial  # noqa: F401
import pandas as pd

pd.set_option("display.width", 120)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)


def _follow_stderr_quietly():
    import sys

    import torch._logging._internal as torch_logging

    torch_logging._StderrHandler.stream = property(
        lambda self: sys.stderr, lambda self, value: None
    )


_follow_stderr_quietly()
```
